question: Should this ClawHub issue remain as a routing note, be migrated to the OpenClaw runtime/browser tracker, or be reframed as ClawHub package/docs work?
rationale: The report is detailed and plausibly actionable, but the code needed to investigate or fix it is outside this repository; automation should pause for maintainer ownership direction rather than open a ClawHub fix PR.

options.title: Migrate to runtime/browser tracker
options.body: Move or cross-link the report to the OpenClaw runtime/browser area so the launcher, logging, and CDP readiness code can be investigated in the owning repository.

options.title: Keep as ClawHub routing note
options.body: Leave this open here only as a triage pointer while maintainers decide where browser runtime reports should live.

options.title: Reframe as ClawHub docs/package metadata
options.body: Only keep ClawHub implementation work if maintainers identify missing registry/package guidance that would help users find the browser plugin or runtime docs.

recommendation.title: Migrate to runtime/browser tracker
recommendation.body: Move or cross-link the report to the OpenClaw runtime/browser area so the launcher, logging, and CDP readiness code can be investigated in the owning repository.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has the clearest current-main history for the ClawHub docs, CLI, and package metadata surfaces that define what this repository owns.
